verdict: Native plain Chat public JSON/SSE continuation, scoped second-body ownership/error cleanup, declared-limit refusal and physical warm-planning acceptance pass. Phase 5/6/W26 and full native memory remain open.

scope.public: 18 actual public ChatSession/OpenAI/local-HTTP cases: none/all/allButLast x initial JSON/SSE x off/remove/summary. Mandatory production tokenizer estimates 49..168, no zero token stub or hook/estimation bypass. Both complete POSTs equal independent old converter and continuation builder bytes with actual Content-Length. One terminal text, one durable normalized tool call. Synthetic acknowledgements stay wire-only. Prior 1,2,3 event ordinals unchanged during both POSTs; user/model commit as 4,5. No operation files. Telemetry/token-usage logging disabled because native log/dump projection remains open. Tool executor is never entered.
scope.lifetime: 8 actual provider/HTTP cases, 40 historical media rows with 64KiB text each: clear/purge x complete/abort/blob read failure/HTTP500. Pause before historical second-body blob read. Purge commits each image removal. Old pin remains readable; complete second body matches independent old bytes. Reclaim=0 while pinned and =1 after last close. Exact non-Error abort reason and original blob failure cause retained. External/pending reservations remain a separate unproved scope.
scope.retention: Independent WeakRefs to actual decoded media-stage units, with GC census isolated from observer input scope, stay <=2 rows/128KiB text and return to zero. This is scoped actual-unit lifetime, not full retained-heap/capacity acceptance. Explicit RowOwnership also returns to zero.
scope.transport: Same captured continuation body retries actual HTTP500 after clear and replacement; retry hash, bytes and Content-Length identical. Separate partially consumed second native body sends an actual HTTP callback request, then callback failure plus independently blocked/failing source close: error cause/ordered errors [callback,close], unresolved until close gate released, every admitted row released. This callback test is not a complete second POST parity case. Existing prepared/unsent/release lifecycle file passes 10/80.
scope.refusal: Production stored facts from 2048 one-at-a-time bounded rows declare a real 134217600-byte first HTTP body. Current decimal/UTF8 call tail crosses unchanged 134217728 limit; exact RangeError before second HTTP entry/connection. Actual accept counters =1. No fake body length, huge input array or raised limit.
scope.planning: Physical descriptor ranges after cold production facts and initial selection/fill, before second emission. Warm capture vs continuation.build/release distinguished. At 40/4000 rows capture reads 20/56, requested bytes 78376/267376; both ROW/LENS overlaps zero. Build/release reads and bytes zero. First/second declared lengths 1939/2080 and 163319/163420. Does not certify general depth complexity, cold fill, other providers or all changed-view combinations.
